components.name: CV link
components.description: A plain navigation link matching the approved concept.
components.css: .ds-cv-link { color: var(--ink, #20242a); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-cv-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #315c8a); } .ds-cv-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #315c8a); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text link
components.description: An ordinary link with a precise underline.
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: var(--ink, #20242a); text-decoration-color: var(--rule, #d6dadf); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.25rem; transition: color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), text-decoration-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-text-link:hover, .ds-text-link:focus-visible { color: var(--accent, #315c8a); text-decoration-color: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: A careful engineer's notebook opened on a clean desk. Large plain-spoken type establishes the thesis, while fine rules and compact labels organize evidence without cards.
keyCharacteristics: One asymmetric hero with generous empty space
Flat sections separated by thin rules
Employer and open-source work kept distinct

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: Mineral blue is the only accent.

rules.name: The Open Canvas Rule
rules.body: Group with spacing and rules, not panels.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: If an element needs a shadow to feel important, its hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Keep the thesis visible on a small laptop.
Use one accent and visible keyboard focus.
Separate employer work from personal open-source work.
donts: Do not use cards, gradients, glass panels, neon styling, dashboards, or skill meters.
Do not publish private infrastructure or unsupported claims.
